# SYNTHETIC REGEX FIXTURE ONLY. Requires clinical review before activation.
schema: validator_lexicon.v1
locale: en
hedges: ["may", "might", "perhaps", "possibly", "it seems"]
question_patterns:
  - '(?i)^\s*(?:what|why|when|how|where|do you|are you|could you)\b'
clinical_labels: ["depression", "anxiety disorder"]
patterns:
  diagnosis:
    - '(?i)\byou (?:have|suffer from) (?:depression|anxiety disorder)\b'

    - '(?i)\b(?:take|increase|stop) (?:your )?(?:medication|antidepressants|\d+\s*(?:mg|pills|tablets))\b'
    - '(?i)\btake \d+\s*(?:mg|pills|tablets)\b'

    - '(?i)\bthis will (?:fix|cure)\b'
  therapist_identity:
    - '(?i)\bas your therapist\b'

  directive_advice:
    - '(?i)\byou (?:should|must|need to)\b'
  internal_leak:
    - '(?i)\b(?:response_plan|memory_id)\b'
  technique:
    - '(?i)\b(?:try|do) (?:a|this) (?:breathing )?exercise\b'
  dependency:
    - '(?i)\bonly i understand you\b'
  invalidating:
    - '(?i)\bjust get over it\b'
  crisis_forbidden:
